blocks.text: Part of our award-winning PSW Pot Collection, this curved planter from Arcadia Garden Products is made from a mix of recycled plastic, stone powder, and wood dust. Great for both indoor and outdoor use, the bottom of the container can be easily drilled using any standard drill bit. The winning combination of recycled ingredients in the PSW line makes this an attractive, lightweight product that is also weather resistant and easy to clean. These pots are available in a variety of colors and feature a smooth, curved shape for visual appeal. A thoughtful gift for those who enjoy plants and planting, PSW Pots have exceptional strength and eye-catching visual appeal. And because it coordinates with other PSW containers, you can choose from a variety of additional matching pots and saucers to make your garden collection complete.

items.label: MADE WITH RECYCLED MATERIALS
items.value: A blend of recycled plastic, stone powder, and wood dust, PSW Pots are eye-catching and long-lasting for mindful gardening.

items.label: Size
items.value: The 16 Inch Curved Planter measures 16.3” width and 9.1” high, with an opening diameter of about 16”.

items.label: LIGHTWEIGHT & DURABLE
items.value: PSW Pots are durable, lightweight, and resistant to weather conditions and UV rays for extended outdoor use.

items.label: ONE-OF-A-KIND
items.value: Due to the blending of recycled materials, every PSW pot is unique with slight variations that infer an artisan’s touch.

items.label: OPTIONAL DRAINAGE
items.value: Easily add drainage holes using any standard drill bit without damaging the integrity of the pot.
